claim: Computational modelling research involves model builders and model viewers as two distinct categories of researchers with different types of expertise.
source: Computational modelling research involves two important, but distinct categories of researchers that tend to have different types of expertise. On the one hand, there are the model builders, the scientists designing the models and performing the research; these are typically computational biologists with at least some basic programming skills. On the other hand, there are the model viewers, members of the broader research community who should be able to access and understand these models once they are built; this group may also include biologists and students without programming expertise.
evidence: This is an observation about the structure of the computational modeling research community.
